title: spermacoce ivorensis
intro: Spermacoce ivorensis, commonly known as Ivorian Spermacoce, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as antibacterial and anti-inflammatory actions, aiding in the treatment of wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce ivorensis include antioxidant, antifungal, and antiplasmodial activities, making it a potential treatment for malaria and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of Spermacoce ivorensis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
